Hon. Scott S. Harris 
Clerk of the Court 
Supreme Court of the United States 
One First Street, N.E. 
Washington, D.C. 20543 

Re:  McKinney v. Arizona, No. 18-1109 

Dear Mr. Harris, 

I am Counsel of Record for Petitioner in this case.  Petitioner respectfully 

requests an additional 7-day extension of time, to and including August 21, 2019, to 
file his opening brief and joint appendix.  Counsel for Respondent has consented to 
this extension. 

In turn, Petitioner has consented to an additional 7-day extension of time for 

Respondent to file its brief, to and including October 17, 2019.  Under the Court's 
rules, Petitioner's reply brief would be due 30 days later (or at the time specified in 
Rule 25.3). 

Thank you for your consideration. 

Respectfully submitted, 

Neal Kumar Katyal 
Counsel of Record  for Petitioner 

cc:  David Robert Cole, Counsel of Record, Arizona Attorney General's Office 

Mark Brnovich, Arizona Attorney General 
Oramel H. Skinner, Arizona Solicitor General
